business_problem: AmTrust needed to turn broker-submitted Excess and Surplus policy requests into comprehensive quotes much faster, but its manual clearance process had to interpret unstructured email packages and attachments before underwriters could even begin tailoring a response.
solution_summary: AmTrust worked with TCS to replace a manual Excess and Surplus clearance flow with a low-code, AI-based automation platform that ingests broker email submissions and their unstructured attachments, classifies each package, extracts policy-relevant fields, validates the captured data, and auto-routes exceptions for human review. TCS designed the solution with AmTrust's COO and IT team, mapping business rules and workflows so the normalized submission data could be formatted consistently and ingested into AmTrust's existing technology stack. Once the workflow completes, underwriters receive an account and shell quote ready for customization instead of starting from raw emails. The rollout covered all E&S products within 12 weeks and turned an expert-heavy intake process into a repeatable digital pipeline.

data_flow: Broker partners send new-business submissions and attachments into the clearance process, where AI based classification extracts policy data from the unstructured files. Data validation checks the captured fields, the automation workflow routes straight-through cases or exceptions as needed, and the normalized package is ingested into AmTrust's technology stack so underwriters receive a ready account and shell quote.
business_outcome: AmTrust shortened its initial underwriting response from a multi-day manual process to same or next day turnaround, processed most submissions within hours, improved broker goodwill, and created the capacity to absorb higher quote volumes without expanding the old manual clearance workflow.
